tasks.title: select bin("") should return 0 instead of null

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: BIN空串及显式转UNSIGNED的两个无表表达式完整，可直接检测NULL/0差异并保留警告。

test_spec.setup: 独立会话，记录sql_mode与字符集，使用单引号避免ANSI_QUOTES影响。
test_spec.steps: SELECT BIN(CAST('' AS UNSIGNED)); SHOW WARNINGS; SELECT BIN(''); SHOW WARNINGS。
test_spec.oracle: 比较结果NULL与0及转换警告；确认该差异是否违反BIN转换契约后再计确认bug。
test_spec.target_applicability: 三个目标均支持BIN/CAST，未知仅该输入行为与缺陷归属。

header.Bug #106225: select bin("") should return 0 instead of null

comments.author: Huaiyu Xu
comments.text:
Description:
mysql> select bin(cast("" as unsigned));
+---------------------------+
| bin(cast("" as unsigned)) |
+---------------------------+
| 0                         |
+---------------------------+
1 row in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> select bin("");
+---------+
| bin("") |
+---------+
| NULL    |
+---------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

How to repeat:
mysql> select bin(cast("" as unsigned));
+---------------------------+
| bin(cast("" as unsigned)) |
+---------------------------+
| 0                         |
+---------------------------+
1 row in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> select bin("");
+---------+
| bin("") |
+---------+
| NULL    |
+---------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

Suggested fix:
`select bin("")` should also return 0
